# Bill Thayer's Penelope

> > A comprehensive digital library of 15,000+ pages featuring American and Roman history, classical Greek and Latin texts, and Italian regional studies.

Created and maintained by Bill Thayer at the University of Chicago, this extensive archive provides primary historical sources, biographical registers, and classical texts with a focus on ancient Rome, American military history, and Italian culture and geography.

## Key Topics

- Bill Thayer
- University of Chicago
- American history
- Roman history
- Classical texts
- Primary sources
- Digital library
- Naval history
- Italian studies
- Gubbio

- Biographical collections
